title.narrative: Providing the distribution of shelter and non-food items for a winter bag in the Republic of Pakistan for the year 2023

description.narrative: Distributing (25,000) shelter bags to needy and affected groups, benefiting (175,000) individuals

Providing (25,000) shelter bags containing (a tent, solar-powered lighting, (2) blankets, a rug, and kitchen tools) and (25,000) winter clothing bags containing (2 blankets, a men’s shawl, a women’s shawl, and socks. Women's, children's and men's hats, women's and men's pajamas, and children's sweaters).
Supporting needy and affected groups in Pakistan in the shelter and non-food items sector, as well as supporting needy and affected people during the winter season.
